- internal VictoryMessageTags

A-priority translation result

Human-reviewed A translation units: 1082

The Korean result currently requires:
  696 unique Hangul syllables

This fits the proven Stage36 512x512 multipage TMR18 structure:
  conservative safe Korean capacity = 756
  remaining safe cells              = 60

Production font:
- preserves all 151 original Latin glyph records byte-for-byte
- preserves the five Stage36-proven Korean glyph indices/positions
- total glyph_count = 847
- actual Korean Unicode high-byte pages = 44
- glyph records + 44 Unicode pages move to known-zero MDI stream23
- stream22 continues to hold the 512x512 CLUT4 atlas

    widths  = [128,128,128,128]
    heights = [256,256,256,256]
    textures = [original TMR texture object] * 4
- descriptor remains:
    A087D020
    A8090200
    B8000909

Why Stage39A does NOT apply all 1082 translations yet
------------------------------------------------------
The font path is proven, but Korean text has so far been inserted at runtime.
Before replacing all .INT values, the game localization loader's on-disc
Unicode encoding must be proven.

Stage39A builds the full 696-syllable production font, then modifies only
localization VALUES equal to "Story" into:

  스토리

No RAM text patch is used.

The tool automatically tries, in this order:
  1. UTF-8
  2. UTF-8 with BOM
  3. UTF-16LE with BOM

For each encoding it boots PPSSPP in normal JIT, repeatedly presses PSP Start,
and reads the proven runtime Story slot.  Success requires BOTH:

  runtime Story slot == UTF-16LE "스토리"

and

  production font runtime checks pass:
    glyph_count 847
    glyph_ptr -> stream23
    all 696 Unicode mappings valid
    atlas SHA1 valid
    descriptor A087D020/A8090200/B8000909

The first successful encoding is saved in SELECTED_ENCODING.txt.
Stage40 can then safely encode and inject all 1082 A-priority translations.

top_candidates.preview:
BIA Stage 39F - Correct narrow-string source + metadata proof

Stage39E failure produced an IMPORTANT positive result.

The PPSSPP log repeatedly caught:

  PC = 0x08C74EAC
  RA = 0x08C71A74
  Write16 into 0x08E4E82C...

Static BIAON.PRX disassembly proves 0x08C74EAC is:

  sh s3,0(s4)

inside a bitstream/MDI decompressor.  The caller at 0x08C71A74 is part of the
same decompression pipeline.

Therefore the Stage39C "byte-wise widened copy" at 0x08E4E82C was NOT proof
of a narrow-to-wide character converter.  Stage39D's decoder hypothesis is
discarded.

More importantly, the original MDI structures expose two Stage39C mistakes.

1. Wrong second "Story" location
--------------------------------
stream11 around +0x5CB20:

  SINGLEPLAYER
  Story          <-- display value #1 at +0x5CB20
  MULTIPLAYER
  Skirmish
  OPTIONS
  Options
  PROFILES
  Profile
  MenuStory      <-- INTERNAL KEY at +0x5CB90
  ...

Stage39C patched +0x5CB94 as a second Story value.

But +0x5CB94 is only the "Story" substring inside the internal key:

  MenuStory

The actual second display value is later:

  TITLE
  Story          <-- display value #2 at +0x5CBD0
  CONTINUE
  Continue
  NEWGAME
  Start New Game

Stage39F therefore restores MenuStory exactly and patches:

  stream11 +0x5CB20
  stream11 +0x5CBD0

only.

2. FString-like length metadata was not updated
------------------------------------------------
stream16 contains pointer / Num / Max triples.

Display #1:
  stream16+0x3F754 -> 0x093B1B40
  +0x3F758 Num = 6
  +0x3F75C Max = 6

Display #2:
  stream16+0x44738 -> 0x093B1BF0
  +0x4473C Num = 6
  +0x44740 Max = 6

Original "Story" is:
  5 bytes + NUL = 6 elements

UTF-8 "스토리" is:
  9 bytes + NUL = 10 elements

Writing 9 UTF-8 bytes without changing Num/Max leaves the string object
logically truncated even if the storage field itself has enough padding.

Stage39F patches both real display values and changes both Num/Max pairs from:

  6 / 6

to:

  10 / 10

No decoder code is modified.

Runtime test
------------
The test starts from the Stage39B production-font ISO when available.  This
avoids inheriting Stage39C's accidental MenuStory-key modification.  If the
Stage39B ISO is missing, Stage39C is accepted as a fallback and the internal
MenuStory key is repaired.

At runtime it first verifies:
- both UTF-8 display values are resident
- MenuStory is intact
- both pointer/Num/Max triples are correct

Only then does it send at most THREE Start presses.

After every press it searches all PSP RAM for:

Real UTF-16LE:
  스토리 = A4 C2 A0 D1 AC B9

and separately for the old byte-wise-widened hypothesis.

It stops immediately when real UTF-16 is found, so it does not repeat the
Stage39C error of continuously pressing Start and leaving the main menu.

The production 847-glyph / 696-Hangul font verifier is also run when available.

Success:
  PROJECT_ROOT\log\bia_stage39f_upload.zip

Failure:
  PROJECT_ROOT\log\fail_bia_sta

# BIA Stage 38B 정제 한국어 번역 배치

각 `batches/bia_translation_clean_batch_XXX.tsv`의 `한국어` 열을 채웁니다.

## 규칙

- `English` 의미를 자연스러운 한국어 게임 문장으로 번역합니다.
- `control_tokens`에 있는 토큰은 종류/개수/순서를 그대로 보존합니다.
- `<PROFILE>`, `%s`, `%d`, `%newline%` 같은 런타임 토큰을 번역하거나 삭제하지 않습니다.
- 고유명사/계급/군사용어를 일관되게 번역합니다.
- `id`, `priority`, `category`, `English`, `control_tokens`,
  `reference_count`, `references`, `quote_styles`는 수정하지 않습니다.
- 확신하기 어려운 행은 `한국어`를 비우고 `메모`에 이유를 적습니다.
- Stage37에서 계산한 글꼴 corpus는 사용하지 않습니다. Stage38의 내부 asset ID 오탐도 Stage38B에서 제거했습니다. 실제 번역이 완료된 후
  이 `한국어` 열들만 모아 한글 고유 음절을 다시 계산합니다.

## 우선순위

- A: 메뉴/UI/시스템/공통 게임 텍스트
- B: 스토리 대사 및 스커미시 미션 텍스트
- C: 엔진/크레딧 등 후순위 텍스트

파일 순서는 A -> B -> C로 정렬되어 있습니다.
